page.notes: The "»" marks in the left margin beside the last four lines are printer's quotation marks, not text, so they are left out. "continuti" may be "continui"; I have kept the printed form and marked it. "formę & temperamenti" and "affici possit?" are read with some uncertainty from a small, slightly blurred print. The drop cap S is joined to the word "Vperioribus". The heading words are small and set in a distinctive typeface; "INSIDEANT?" is set in italic. The page is otherwise clean, with show-through from the reverse side only.
